Eat well without giving up the food you love.

I'm Ines, an accredited dietitian in Melbourne. I help busy adults sort out energy slumps, gut trouble and weight goals with simple meals that fit real life.

Book a first consultSee meal plans
9 years in practice1,200+ clientsMedicare rebates for eligible clients
No banned foodsPlans in 5 days

How I can help

Every client starts with a 60-minute consult. We look at what you eat now, how you feel, and what would make the biggest difference first.

Weight goals

Slow, steady changes you can keep. No shakes, no counting every almond.

Gut health

Help with bloating, IBS and food intolerances, including the low FODMAP diet.

Energy and sport

Fuel for training, long shifts and busy days, so you stop crashing at 3pm.

Heart and blood sugar

Food plans for cholesterol, blood pressure and type 2 diabetes, with your GP.

Meal plan packages

Each plan is written for you, with shopping lists and swaps for the foods you don't like.

How much water do you need?

A quick guide based on your weight, how active you are and the weather. Food and other drinks count too, so this is a daily target, not a rule.

Weather

2.4 L

About 10 glasses of 250 ml

If you have kidney or heart problems, ask your doctor about your fluid needs.

Book a first consult

60 minutes in my Fitzroy clinic or on video. $150, with Medicare and private health rebates where eligible.

"I thought I'd have to give up bread and wine. Ines showed me how to keep both and still lose 9 kg over six months."

Client, age 44

© Leaf & Ladle Nutrition, 210 Brunswick St, Fitzroy VIC

# Nutritionist

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/health-fitness/nutritionist/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
